hero.caption: The original design plan for Norris Dam, built by the TVA on the Clinch River in Tennessee, USA.  TVA adopted the design from a previous design the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers had drafted for the "Cove Creek Project" in the late 1920s.  The design was modified with the help of U.S. Bureau of Land Reclamation engineers.
